newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian 1996 budget deficit 3.4% of GDP - ministries.
newsitem.headline: Belgian 1996 budget deficit 3.4% of GDP - ministries.

text.p: The Belgian 1996 budget deficit was 3.4 percent of Gross Domestic Product in 1996, the Belgian budget and finance ministries said in a statement.
This was higher than the government's forecast which had been for 3.2 percent.
In 1995 the deficit was 4.1 percent of GDP, and the government target for 1997 is 2.9 percent.
The ministries also said that the net government borrowing requirement was 242.9 billion francs in 1996, down from 290.1 billion in 1995.
Total Belgian government gross debt fell to 130.2 percent of GDP at the end of 1996 from 133.7 percent at the end of 1995, the ministries said.
